description: T6: a README written by write_file documents a declared read-only tool three times (`<function=list_dir>...</function>` between lines of text). Each documented call ends the value as written only with a repair (the wrapper closer inserted before text), so the value holds them all: one write_file call with the full content, and no list_dir call is read from it (each would run).
input:
<tool_call>
<function=write_file>
<parameter=path>
README.md
</parameter>
<parameter=content>
To list a directory:
<function=list_dir>
<parameter=dir>
src
</parameter>
</function>
or the tests:
<function=list_dir>
<parameter=dir>
tests
</parameter>
</function>
or the docs:
<function=list_dir>
<parameter=dir>
docs
</parameter>
</function>
That is all.
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
